project_title: An Uncertainty-Aware, Budget-Constrained Multi-View Framework for Cost-Efficient Academic Integrity Detection

gates.evidence: Exact finite-sample order statistic and linear fusion equations match across docs 03, 04, and audit script.
Strict separation between Train (4000), Val (1500), Cal-Prob (1000), Cal-Conf (1000), and Test (3000).
Exact order statistic k = ceil((n+1)(1-eps)) verified; interpolated percentiles rejected.
Case-05 proved degenerate under group-disjoint splits; raw decision margins enforced as exploratory signal.
19,666 raw rows reconciled to 10,500 active, 9,158 reserve, and 8 purged rows with 0 discrepancy.
733 raw pairs, 24 duplicate rows, 11 groups; Policy A retains 720 pairs, Policy B retains 709 pairs.
Zero premise overlap across all 7 text partitions; 0 reversed pairs in text and code.
Group-aware bootstrap specified; code task generalization explicitly bounded due to 2 test tasks.
Separated Text Cross-Encoder (MiniLM) from Code Stage-2 Detector (hybrid structural-semantic model).
Decomposed into 10 operations; 0.050 ms identified as pre-indexed dot product design target.
DOIs verified for Setu 2025, Sulistiani 2019, Gandhi 2024, Mehsen 2024; SNLI proxy limitations stated.
Components classified as DESIGN_SPECIFIED vs SOURCE_IMPLEMENTED; no false claims of completion.
run_final_phase2_audit.py executes completely with exit code 0 and verifies all assertions.
All 16 deliverables in phase_2_final/ report identical counts, denominators, and gate statuses.
Comprehensive blueprint (Phases 3.1 to 3.8) and execution plan provide actionable implementation roadmap.

declared_limitations: IR-Plag case-05 exhibits single-class topology under group-disjoint splits; probability calibration is structurally impossible, requiring exploratory raw margin thresholding.
Historical git commit log prior to Phase 2 is absent; current baseline state is frozen via SHA-256 fingerprints.
Code Stage-2 cross-encoder detector was not pre-trained in original baseline; designed as hybrid structural-semantic classifier for Phase 3 implementation.
SNLI text benchmark serves as a controlled semantic inference proxy benchmark; full institutional deployment requires fine-tuning on domain-specific academic essays.
